notes.title: Hello! I'd like to announce a price reduction for my game.
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

This is Khant, the solo developer of 'Dami and the Secret Library.'

To reach more players, I've decided to lower the game's price from 3,000 KRW to 1,000 KRW. This decision was made considering that the game's content is somewhat limited and there aren't many activities to enjoy just yet.

With this price reduction, I hope to meet more players and help the game gain more exposure.

I'm currently working on improving various parts of the game, and I'll continue to provide updates to enhance your experience.

Thank you!

notes.title: Hello! This is developer Khant.
notes.notes:
The game that I’ve been developing solo for years has finally been released.
I’m excited to meet all of you on Steam.
Although I’m still lacking in many areas as a developer,
I hope to continue making games together with you for the upcoming second and third episodes and beyond.
Thank you! :)
